data.one_liner: A slider widget with a floating balloon animation and material design look.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customized slider widget that displays a floating balloon animation inspired by Balloon Picker. It allows users to select values with visual feedback including a rope and balloon UI element.
use_when: You want to display a slider with a custom balloon animation in a Flutter app.
You need a material design slider that visually resembles a floating balloon.
avoid_when: You require a standard, default material slider without custom animations.
You need complex form validation integration out of the box.
strengths: Adds a unique visual flair to standard slider interactions.
weaknesses: Very limited configuration options documented in the basic usage.
Niche widget with few features beyond the initial balloon animation.
data.minimal_example:
BalloonSlider(
    value: 0.5,
    ropeLength: 55,
    showRope: true,
    onChangeStart: (val) {},
    onChanged: (val) {},
    onChangeEnd: (val) {},
    color: Colors.indigo
)
